rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched the returned user_id to the order’s user_id, and provided accurate order status (pending, no ETA, no fulfillments). The agent did not perform any order-changing action without explicit confirmation. When the user asked to cancel a single item, the agent stated it wasn’t possible and offered alternatives. The user then opted to cancel the whole order with a refund to gift card; the agent correctly noted the payment was via credit card and clarified refund policy and the need for a gift card on account, seeking confirmation before proceeding. After the user declined (no gift card and thus no cancellation), the agent left the order unchanged, aligning with the user’s stated conditions. Minor caveat: the claim that item-level cancellation isn’t possible wasn’t supported by a tool check, but no incorrect action was taken and the final outcome matched policy and user preferences.
